 assert Path(copies['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(copies['public']['path']).read_bytes()

for source in prep['source_texts']+sources['additional_sources']:
 assert ref(source['path'])['sha256']==source['sha256'] and Path(source['path']).read_text()==source['text'];source_checks+=1

 assert ref(source['path'])['sha256']==source['sha256'] and Path(source['path']).read_text()==source['text'];source_checks+=1
assert runtime_fix['all_original_frozen_files_unchanged'] and runtime_fix['new_scientific_forwards_before_relaunch']==0

for endpoint,binding in final['checkpoints'].items():
 assert ref(binding['export']['path'])==binding['export'];state=torch.load(binding['export']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
 module=LateNonlocalResidualDetail(**state['module_config']);module.load_state_dict(state['state_dict'],strict=True)
 assert model_hash(module)==binding['module_hash'] and model_hash(module.frozen)==binding['frozen_module_hash']
 assert len(module.state_dict())==188 and len(module.network.state_dict())==141 and sum(p.numel() for p in module.network.parameters())==2088906
 assert state['frozen_component']==plan['frozen_component'] and ref(state['source']['path'])==state['source']

bindings=read(root/'report-bindings-v1.json');report=repo/'docs/learned-matching-residual.md';text=report.read_text();assert ref(report)==bindings['report']==final['report']
for cell in bindings['cells']:
 s=summary[cell['kind'],cell['condition'],cell['cohort'],cell['method']];assert f"{s[cell['field']]:.{cell['digits']}f}"==cell['rendered']
for line in bindings['lines']:assert line in text
native=read(final['figures']['path']);assert len(native['images'])==60 and sum(i['triplet'] for i in native['images'])==12
prior=read(plan['prior_figures']['path']);old_map={i['image']['path']:i for i in prior['images']};new_channels=copied_channels=0
for item in native['images']:
 old=old_map[item['source_figure']['path']]
 assert ref(item['image']['path'])==item['image'] and item['source_figure']==old['image'] and item['no_resize']
 assert Path(item['image']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['original_image']['path']).read_bytes()
 for field in ['ROI_xywh','anchor','contrast','exposure']:assert item[field]==old[field]

 for panel in item['panels']:
  name=panel['label'];x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];assert w==h==160
  if name in item['predictions']:
   b=item['predictions'][name];assert ref(b['path'])==b;value=np.load(b['path']);expected=independent_display(anchor+item['contrast']*(value.astype(np.float64)-anchor),a,item['ROI_xywh'],item['exposure']);new_channels+=expected.size
  else:
   label={'V169 EMA':'balanced-EMA'}.get(name,name);p=old_panels[label];ox,oy,ow,oh=p['xywh'];expected=old_image[oy:oy+oh,ox:ox+ow];copied_channels+=expected.size
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y:y+h,x:x+w],expected)
